title: Lionel Hampton as a boy and on the Goodman date
summary: Hamp humming; got him the session.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Tell me something about Lionel. You told me something about when he was a kid, used to play on the curb, and so forth.
Yeah, we used to go down on the curb, stand around the picket fences and sidewalk. Still humming like he does now. He was humming then.
Yeah, one of the great jazz grunters.
Well, did you re-establish contact with him in the thirties? Well, obviously if you --
I lost contact. The only thing, I just heard about him being out on the Coast, and the different bands he was in. Then I heard right when he organized his old band.
Yeah, but before then, was this Goodman session, and you said that he got you on this session.
He got me on that session, yeah. He was traveling with Benny then.
So he still remembered you and --
Yeah, he played on the session.
